# Anouk Philipsen

> Anouk Philipsen is a Dutch artist who makes abstract paintings in which colour, form and movement come together. Her work is characterised by intuitive expression, organic forms and bold colour combinations; each painting is born from feeling. Her paintings are currently on view at Gallery Rembrandt in Eindhoven, the Netherlands.

Nederlands: Anouk Philipsen is een Nederlandse kunstenaar die abstracte schilderijen maakt waarin kleur, vorm en beweging samenkomen. Haar werk kenmerkt zich door intuïtieve expressie, organische vormen en krachtige kleurcombinaties. Haar schilderijen zijn te zien bij Gallery Rembrandt in Eindhoven.

- Gallery Rembrandt, Kleine Berg 42, 5611 JV Eindhoven, the Netherlands — https://www.galleryrembrandt.nl

## Collection

- Six abstract paintings, shown in interiors: green and white; brown, white and black; brown and cream (wide format); cream and burgundy; copper, black and white; warm brown tones. Images: https://anoukphilipsen.com/sitemap.xml
